corrections.reason: Both the printed glyph (showing the 2nd-order ಕಾዕብ stroke on the right leg of ሡ) and Ge'ez plural agreement with ወሰሚዖሙ and the Amharic gloss ማልደው ፡ ገስግሰው confirm ጌሡ.
The printed glyph in Column 2 Line 30 is clearly 6th-order ር (ነገር ፡ ሠራ, standard Amharic Andemta idiom for 'he informed / made a report'), not 7th-order ሮ.
